newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end lower in all months.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end lower in all months.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures closed lower across the board on Tuesday, as the bearish sentiment remained following the Monday's price falls, traders said.
Prices were 1.2 yen to 1.7 yen per kilogram lower. And benchmark April settled 1.3 yen weaker at 140.9 yen.
Selling from local investors emerged at the opening, due to a lack of bullish factor, traders said. The yen's gains against the dollar accelerated selling orders, they said.
"We foresee further selling pressure when the benchmark April falls below 140 yen," a brokerage house trader said. -- Tokyo Commodity Desk +81-3-3432-7391
